name: chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 4

function.text: CHD4 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD4. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription coregulator binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Sifrim-Hitz-Weiss syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: CHD4 encodes ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler CHD4. Based in part on similarity, it is an ATP-dependent chromatin-remodeling factor that binds and distorts nucleosomal DNA. It functions as a component of the histone deacetylase NuRD complex which participates in the remodeling of chromatin. It localizes to acetylated damaged chromatin in a ZMYND8-dependent manner, to promote transcriptional repression and double-strand break repair by homologous recombination.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Sifrim-Hitz-Weiss syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CHD4 have been reported in DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma, colon adenocarcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.
